notices.message: Renders derive from sources carrying a declared "lab-stats-transfer" tone transform toward y045_e00. sdlab records the declaration and hashes the operands; it does NOT verify the transform was applied or is reversible. Colour measurements on these records — palette gate, class shares, ΔE — sit downstream of it.

Renders are declared "emit" derivations of the accepted asset, not generated images — so they carry no seed or generation frame, correctly. Records carry generation: null by declaration rather than by omission. The generating provenance of any twins these were projected from belongs to those twins, not to these records.
